verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Persona's product features (inquiries, workflows, reports, sandbox, webhooks) but contains no documentation about legal bases for biometric data processing, GDPR lawful basis, BIPA or other US biometric statutes, or model consent language for legal review. Missing for 10: GDPR lawful-basis documentation, BIPA/state biometric statute compliance guidance, sample consent language, and any legal/compliance whitepaper addressing biometric data handling.
